simulated_datasets.description: Random nucleotide sequence datasets generated under controlled sequence-length and sequence-number settings.

real_biological_datasets.description: Benchmark datasets constructed from publicly available complete bacteriophage genome sequences in the NCBI Nucleotide database.
real_biological_datasets.fragment_construction: Fragments of required lengths were sequentially truncated from the beginning of the corresponding complete genome sequences.
real_biological_datasets.accession_information: The original NCBI accession numbers and source links are listed in the Original data sources section of the GitHub README file.
